# GO-stratified soluble-abundance age log2FC correlations

These analyses use **soluble-proteome abundance** but remain locked to the same sex-independent Adult Control soluble starting pool defined above (>=2 Adult Control soluble detections total regardless of sex). Female and male age effects are then estimated separately only when that protein has at least 2 valid soluble measurements in both Adult and Old within the relevant sex. Combined and individual component final-size PNGs and editable SVGs are saved in metric-specific `SolFC` folders. The individual output IDs include the metric to ensure reliable one-figure re-export.

```{r adultold-go-log2fc-correlations, fig.keep="none"}
# Start from the SAME fixed Adult-soluble pool used above. Sex-specific soluble
# age effects are estimated only when >=2 positive measurements are available in
# both Adult and Old for that sex. Sex does not determine starting-pool entry.
sol_age_group_mean <- sol_sample_level %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(Abundance), Abundance > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Protein_ID, Sex, Age) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Mean_Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Age, values_from = c(Mean_Abundance, n)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(Mean_Abundance_Adult),
    is.finite(Mean_Abundance_Old),
    Mean_Abundance_Adult > 0,
    Mean_Abundance_Old > 0,
    n_Adult >= min_detected,
    n_Old >= min_detected
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(log2FC = log2(Mean_Abundance_Old / Mean_Abundance_Adult))

age_fc_go <- sol_age_group_mean %>%
  dplyr::left_join(adult_propensity %>% dplyr::select(Protein_ID, Bin), by = "Protein_ID") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(metrics_long, by = "Protein_ID", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Bin %in% display_bins, is.finite(Metric_Score)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Bin = factor(Bin, levels = display_bins), Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")))

age_go_cor_stats <- age_fc_go %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Metric, Bin, Sex) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ safe_cor_stats(.x)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

readr::write_csv(age_go_cor_stats, file.path(nat_dirs$SolFC, "AO_SolFC_cor.csv"))

for (metric in metric_levels) {

  dd <- age_fc_go %>%
    dplyr::filter(Metric == metric) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Bin, Sex) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(Protein_ID) >= min_go_n) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  strip_stats <- age_go_cor_stats %>%
    dplyr::filter(Metric == metric, Bin %in% unique(dd$Bin)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Bin, Sex, r, p) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stat_text = paste0(Sex, ": r=", ifelse(is.na(r), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", r)), ", p=", fmt_p3(p))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Bin, Sex, stat_text) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Sex, values_from = stat_text) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Bin_lab = paste0(
        "<b>",
        as.character(Bin),
        "</b><br><span style='font-size:6pt;font-weight:normal;'>",
        Female,
        " | ",
        Male,
        "</span>"
      )
    )

  dd <- dd %>%
    dplyr::left_join(strip_stats %>% dplyr::select(Bin, Bin_lab), by = "Bin")

  bin_lab_levels <- strip_stats %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Bin = factor(as.character(Bin), levels = display_bins)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Bin) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Bin_lab)

  dd <- dd %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Bin_lab = factor(Bin_lab, levels = bin_lab_levels))

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(dd, ggplot2::aes(x = log2FC, y = Metric_Score)) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = nm_style$axis_line) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(colour = Sex, shape = Sex), size = nm_style$point_medium, alpha = 0.62) +
    ggplot2::geom_smooth(
      ggplot2::aes(colour = Sex, fill = Sex, group = Sex),
      method = "lm",
      formula = y ~ x,
      se = TRUE,
      alpha = 0.10,
      linewidth = nm_style$data_line,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = sex_cols, guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = sex_cols, guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = sex_shapes, breaks = c("Female", "Male"), name = "Sex") +
    ggplot2::guides(
      shape = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(colour = unname(sex_cols[c("Female", "Male")]), size = 1.8, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ Bin_lab, ncol = 4, scales = "free") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("Adult vs Old soluble abundance log2FC vs ", metric, " by cellular component"),
      x = "Soluble abundance age effect, log2FC (Old / Adult)",
      y = metric_y_labels[[metric]],
      shape = "Sex"
    ) +
    theme_nm(legend_position = "right") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(
        family = nm_style$font_family,
        size = nm_style$strip_text,
        lineheight = 1.02
      )
    )

  save_component_fc_figures(
    plot = p,
    plot_data = dd,
    metric = metric,
    file_prefix = "AO_SolFC",
    comparison_label = "Adult vs Old soluble abundance"
  )
}
```

# Detection-defined propensity: Old-predominant insoluble proteins

This complementary analysis starts from the proteins classified as **Old-predominant** in
`OldPredominant_bySex.csv`, independently in females and males, and asks whether
they have higher intrinsic aggregation-propensity scores than proteins with
stable insoluble detection across Adult and Old control samples.

The primary analysis now **matches the original Old-predominant detection
figures**: selected proteins must have **at most one Adult control insoluble
detection and at least two Old control insoluble detections** in the
corresponding sex. Stable comparators are proteins detected in at least two
Adult and two Old control insoluble samples of the same sex. Cases and
comparators must have a matching protein accession and an available intrinsic
score.

Two figure sets are exported:

1. **All Old-predominant proteins**.
2. **Detection-significant Old-predominant proteins only** (`p_detect_age < 0.05`
   in the detection analysis).

Each score is expressed as a percentile **relative to all proteins detected in
at least two Old insoluble samples within that sex**. We test the directional
prediction that Old-predominant proteins have higher scores than stable
proteins, separately for Na4vSS, TANGO, and WALTZ. The exploratory one-sided
Wilcoxon test, one-sided Fisher enrichment above the 75th baseline score
percentile, and a permutation sensitivity test preserve the number of
selected/stable proteins within each GO cellular-component bin. P-values are
adjusted by BH within sex across the three metrics. Raw detection thresholds,
score coverage, selected proteins, individual scores, and testing sample sizes
are exported. Detection is not direct evidence of aggregation.

```{r ao-detection-defined-propensity, fig.keep='none'}
# Detection-defined aggregation propensity: Old-predominant proteins in the
# aged insoluble fraction. Sequence-derived propensity is assessed independently
# from the original detection testing.

nm_det_read <- function(candidates) {
  found <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (!length(found)) stop(
    "Detection input not found. Put the supplied detection CSV in the Rmd ",
    "working directory. Searched: ", paste(candidates, collapse = ", ")
  )
  readr::read_csv(found[[1]], show_col_types = FALSE)
}

nm_det_score <- function(eligible, metric_names = metric_levels) {
  eligible %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(metric_names), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Score") %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(Score)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Sex, Metric) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Percentile = 100 * dplyr::percent_rank(Score)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = metric_names))
}

nm_det_test <- function(scored, pattern, sex, metric, reference = "Stable", n_perm = 1999L) {
  dd <- scored %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sex == sex, as.character(Metric) == metric, Pattern %in% c(pattern, reference)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Protein_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
  x <- dd$Percentile[dd$Pattern == pattern]
  y <- dd$Percentile[dd$Pattern == reference]
  nc <- length(x); nr <- length(y)
  med_delta <- if (nc && nr) stats::median(x) - stats::median(y) else NA_real_
  auc <- if (nc && nr) mean(vapply(
    x, function(z) mean(as.numeric(z > y) + 0.5 * as.numeric(z == y)), numeric(1)
  )) else NA_real_
  case_top25 <- sum(x >= 75)
  stable_top25 <- sum(y >= 75)
  fisher_top25 <- if (nc >= 2L && nr >= 2L) {
    tryCatch(stats::fisher.test(
      matrix(c(case_top25, nc - case_top25, stable_top25, nr - stable_top25), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
      alternative = "greater")$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  } else NA_real_
  p_w <- if (nc >= 2L && nr >= 2L) {
    tryCatch(stats::wilcox.test(x, y, alternative = "greater", exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)$p.value,
             error = function(e) NA_real_)
  } else NA_real_

  overlapping <- dd %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Bin) %>%
    dplyr::filter(any(Pattern == pattern), any(Pattern == reference)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  n_case_overlap <- sum(overlapping$Pattern == pattern)
  n_ref_overlap <- sum(overlapping$Pattern == reference)
  observed <- if (n_case_overlap >= 2L && n_ref_overlap >= 2L) {
    mean(overlapping$Percentile[overlapping$Pattern == pattern]) -
      mean(overlapping$Percentile[overlapping$Pattern == reference])
  } else NA_real_
  p_strat <- NA_real_
  if (is.finite(observed) && n_perm >= 99L) {
    set.seed(1807L + match(sex, c("Female", "Male")) * 101L + match(metric, metric_levels) * 13L + nchar(pattern))
    by_bin <- split(seq_len(nrow(overlapping)), as.character(overlapping$Bin))
    case_n <- vapply(by_bin, function(idx) sum(overlapping$Pattern[idx] == pattern), integer(1))
    perm_effect <- replicate(n_perm, {
      is_case <- rep(FALSE, nrow(overlapping))
      for (b in names(by_bin)) {
        idx <- by_bin[[b]]
        is_case[sample(idx, size = case_n[[b]], replace = FALSE)] <- TRUE
      }
      mean(overlapping$Percentile[is_case]) -
        mean(overlapping$Percentile[!is_case])
    })
    p_strat <- (1 + sum(perm_effect >= observed - 1e-12)) / (n_perm + 1)
  }
  tibble::tibble(
    Sex = sex, Pattern = pattern, Metric = metric,
    n_selected = nc, n_stable = nr,
    median_percentile_selected = if (nc) stats::median(x) else NA_real_,
    median_percentile_stable = if (nr) stats::median(y) else NA_real_,
    median_difference_pp = med_delta,
    AUC_probability_selected_higher = auc,
    n_selected_top_quartile = case_top25,
    n_stable_top_quartile = stable_top25,
    p_Fisher_top_quartile_one_sided = fisher_top25,
    p_Wilcoxon_one_sided = p_w,
    n_case_within_bin = n_case_overlap,
    n_stable_within_bin = n_ref_overlap,
    delta_mean_pp_within_overlap_bins = observed,
    p_permutation_within_bin_one_sided = p_strat
  )
}

nm_det_test_all <- function(scored, patterns) {
  test_grid <- tidyr::crossing(Sex = c("Female", "Male"), Pattern = patterns, Metric = metric_levels)
  purrr::pmap_dfr(test_grid, function(Sex, Pattern, Metric) {
    nm_det_test(scored, as.character(Pattern), as.character(Sex), as.character(Metric))
  }) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Sex) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      FDR_Wilcoxon_BH = stats::p.adjust(p_Wilcoxon_one_sided, "BH"),
      FDR_top_quartile_BH = stats::p.adjust(p_Fisher_top_quartile_one_sided, "BH"),
      FDR_within_bin_BH = stats::p.adjust(p_permutation_within_bin_one_sided, "BH")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

nm_fmt_p <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(is.na(x) ~ "NA", x < 0.001 ~ "<0.001", TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", x))
}

nm_det_stat_strip <- function(test_df, pattern) {
  # Complete facet labels include the statistical tests. This places the
  # statistics INSIDE the bordered strip, not in the data coordinates.
  panels <- c("Female — Na4vSS", "Female — TANGO", "Female — WALTZ %",
              "Male — Na4vSS", "Male — TANGO", "Male — WALTZ %")
  labels <- stats::setNames(paste0("<b>", panels, "</b>"), panels)
  if (is.null(test_df)) return(labels)
  tab <- test_df %>% dplyr::filter(Pattern == pattern)
  fmt <- function(x) gsub("<", "&lt;", nm_fmt_p(x), fixed = TRUE)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(tab))) {
    z <- tab[i, ]
    key <- paste(z$Sex, as.character(z$Metric), sep = " — ")
    labels[[key]] <- paste0(
      "<span style='font-size:7pt;'><b>", key, "</b></span>",
      "<br><span style='font-size:5.6pt;'>Wilcoxon: p = ",
      fmt(z$p_Wilcoxon_one_sided), " | BH q = ", fmt(z$FDR_Wilcoxon_BH),
      "</span><br><span style='font-size:5.6pt;'>Fisher: p = ",
      fmt(z$p_Fisher_top_quartile_one_sided), " | BH q = ",
      fmt(z$FDR_top_quartile_BH), "</span>"
    )
  }
  labels
}

nm_det_distribution <- function(scored, pattern, chart_title, component_cols,
                                tests_df = NULL, show_detection_sig = FALSE) {
  dd <- scored %>%
    dplyr::filter(Pattern %in% c("Stable", pattern)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Pattern = factor(Pattern, levels = c("Stable", pattern)),
      Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
      Bin = factor(Bin, levels = names(component_cols)),
      Label = dplyr::if_else(is.na(Gene) | Gene == "", Protein_ID, Gene),
      SigStatus = dplyr::if_else(Significant %in% TRUE, "Nominal p ≤ 0.05", "NS"),
      Panel = factor(paste0(Sex, " — ", Metric),
                     levels = c("Female — Na4vSS", "Female — TANGO", "Female — WALTZ %",
                                "Male — Na4vSS", "Male — TANGO", "Male — WALTZ %"))
    )
  stable_df <- dd %>% dplyr::filter(Pattern == "Stable")
  selected_df <- dd %>% dplyr::filter(Pattern == pattern)
  sig_df <- selected_df %>% dplyr::filter(SigStatus == "Nominal p ≤ 0.05")
  ns_df  <- selected_df %>% dplyr::filter(SigStatus == "NS")
  label_df <- selected_df %>% dplyr::filter(Percentile > 75)
  strip_labels <- nm_det_stat_strip(tests_df, pattern)

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
      data = stable_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile),
      width = 0.56, alpha = 0.22, outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.25, color = "#9E9E9E", fill = "#D0D0D0"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
      data = selected_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile),
      width = 0.56, alpha = 0.16, outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.25, color = "#7F7F7F", fill = "#D0D0D0"
    )

  if (show_detection_sig) {
    p <- p +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = ns_df,
        ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile, color = Bin, shape = SigStatus),
        position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 2407),
        size = 1.35, alpha = 0.90, stroke = 0.35
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = sig_df,
        ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile, color = Bin, shape = SigStatus),
        position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 2407),
        size = 1.35, alpha = 0.90, stroke = 0.35
      )
  } else {
    p <- p +
      ggplot2::geom_point(
        data = selected_df,
        ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile, color = Bin),
        position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 2407),
        size = 1.25, alpha = 0.85
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = Pattern, y = Percentile, label = Label, color = Bin),
      size = 2.0,
      direction = "both",
      box.padding = 0.22,
      point.padding = 0.14,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      segment.size = 0.18,
      segment.alpha = 0.8,
      force = 2.0,
      force_pull = 0.15,
      max.time = 2,
      seed = 2407,
      show.legend = FALSE,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ Panel, ncol = 3, drop = FALSE, labeller = ggplot2::as_labeller(strip_labels)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 75, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.18, color = "grey65") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = component_cols, drop = FALSE, name = "Cellular component") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
                                limits = c(0, 100),
                                expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.025))) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = chart_title,
      subtitle = if (show_detection_sig) {
        ">75th percentile selected proteins are labeled; open points = NS, filled points = nominal detection P ≤ 0.05"
      } else {
        ">75th percentile selected proteins are labeled; point colors indicate cellular component"
      },
      x = NULL, y = "Intrinsic aggregation score percentile"
    ) +
    theme_nm(legend_position = "right") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(
        size = 7, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 1.12,
        family = nm_style$font_family,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 0.9, b = 0.9, unit = "mm")
      )
    )

  if (show_detection_sig) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c("NS" = 1, "Nominal p ≤ 0.05" = 16), name = "Detection test")
  }

  p
}

nm_det_protein_plot <- function(scored, selected_pattern, selected_sex, metric_shapes, component_cols) {
  dd <- scored %>%
    dplyr::filter(Pattern == selected_pattern, Sex == selected_sex) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Label = dplyr::if_else(is.na(Gene) | Gene == "", Protein_ID, Gene),
      Bin = factor(Bin, levels = names(component_cols)),
      BinColor = dplyr::coalesce(unname(component_cols[as.character(Bin)]), "#7A7A7A")
    )
  if (!nrow(dd)) return(NULL)
  order_genes <- dd %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Protein_ID, Label, Bin, BinColor) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(Average = mean(Percentile), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Average, Label) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      UniqueLabel = make.unique(as.character(Label)),
      LabelMarkdown = paste0("<span style='color:", BinColor, ";'>", UniqueLabel, "</span>")
    )
  dd <- dd %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      order_genes %>% dplyr::select(Protein_ID, UniqueLabel, LabelMarkdown, Bin),
      by = c("Protein_ID", "Bin")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(UniqueLabel = factor(UniqueLabel, levels = order_genes$UniqueLabel))

  label_map <- stats::setNames(order_genes$LabelMarkdown, order_genes$UniqueLabel)

  ggplot2::ggplot(dd, ggplot2::aes(x = Percentile, y = UniqueLabel)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
  ggplot2::aes(shape = Metric, color = Bin, fill = Bin),
  position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.12, seed = 108),
  size = 2.0,
  stroke = 0.35
) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = metric_shapes, drop = FALSE, name = "Aggregation metric") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = component_cols, name = "Cellular component") +

ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = scales::alpha(component_cols, 0.35), guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(labels = label_map) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Aggregation score percentile",
      y = NULL,
      title = paste(selected_pattern, "—", selected_sex),
      subtitle = "Protein names are colored by cellular component; shapes indicate aggregation metric"
    ) +
    theme_nm(legend_position = "right") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.15),
      axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(
        family = nm_style$font_family,
        size = nm_style$axis_text,
        colour = "black"
      )
    )
}

nm_det_metric_shapes <- c(
  "Na4vSS" = 21,  # Circle
  "TANGO" = 24,   # Triangle
  "WALTZ %" = 22  # Square
)

det_component_cols <- c(adult_component_cols, "Other/Unassigned" = "#7A7A7A")

# INPUT — change candidate names here only if you renamed your CSV.

}

# Rebuild the full insoluble sex-specific baseline, with no Adult-soluble gate.
ao_ins_counts <- make_fraction_sample_data(insoluble_raw_dat, "Insoluble") %>%

for (column in c("N_Adult", "N_Old")) {

}

ao_ins_annotation <- insoluble_raw_dat %>%

ao_det_base <- ao_ins_counts %>%

  ) %>%

ao_det_audit <- ao_selected %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ao_ins_counts, by = c("Sex", "Protein_ID")) %>%

ao_det_scored_base <- nm_det_score(ao_det_base)

nm_det_prepare_subset <- function(scored_base, keep_significant = FALSE) {
  selected_flag <- if (keep_significant) "Selected_Sig" else "Selected_All"
  scored_base %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Pattern = dplyr::case_when(.data[[selected_flag]] ~ "Old-predominant", Stable ~ "Stable", TRUE ~ "Other")
    )
}

ao_det_scored_all <- nm_det_prepare_subset(ao_det_scored_base, keep_significant = FALSE)
ao_det_scored_sig <- nm_det_prepare_subset(ao_det_scored_base, keep_significant = TRUE)

readr::write_csv(
  ao_det_scored_all %>% dplyr::filter(Pattern %in% c("Old-predominant", "Stable")),
  file.path(ao_det_dir, "AO_Detection_MetricPercentiles_All.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  ao_det_scored_sig %>% dplyr::filter(Pattern %in% c("Old-predominant", "Stable")),
  file.path(ao_det_dir, "AO_Detection_MetricPercentiles_Significant.csv")
)

ao_det_tests_all <- nm_det_test_all(ao_det_scored_all, "Old-predominant") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Subset = "All")
ao_det_tests_sig <- nm_det_test_all(ao_det_scored_sig, "Old-predominant") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Subset = "Significant")
readr::write_csv(ao_det_tests_all, file.path(ao_det_dir, "AO_Detection_Propensity_Tests_All.csv"))
readr::write_csv(ao_det_tests_sig, file.path(ao_det_dir, "AO_Detection_Propensity_Tests_Significant.csv"))
print(ao_det_tests_all)
print(ao_det_tests_sig)

p_ao_detect <- nm_det_distribution(
  ao_det_scored_all, "Old-predominant",
  "Old-predominant detection: aggregation propensity",
  det_component_cols,
  tests_df = ao_det_tests_all,
  show_detection_sig = TRUE
)
save_nat_figure(
  p_ao_detect, file.path(ao_det_dir, "AO_Detect_Propensity.svg"),
  size_key = "fc_grid", save_legend = TRUE
)

p_ao_detect_sig <- nm_det_distribution(
  ao_det_scored_sig, "Old-predominant",
  "Old-predominant detection: aggregation propensity (significant proteins only)",
  det_component_cols,
  tests_df = ao_det_tests_sig,
  show_detection_sig = FALSE
)
save_nat_figure(
  p_ao_detect_sig, file.path(ao_det_dir, "AO_Detect_Propensity_Sig.svg"),
  size_key = "fc_grid", save_legend = TRUE
)

for (sx in c("Female", "Male")) {
  dd_all <- ao_det_scored_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sex == sx, Pattern == "Old-predominant")
  p_all <- nm_det_protein_plot(ao_det_scored_all, "Old-predominant", sx, nm_det_metric_shapes, det_component_cols)
  if (!is.null(p_all)) {
    id_all <- paste0("AO_Detect_Proteins_", sx)
    save_nat_figure(
      p_all, file.path(ao_det_dir, paste0(id_all, ".svg")),
      size_key = "shift_sex", save_legend = TRUE
    )
  }

  dd_sig <- ao_det_scored_sig %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sex == sx, Pattern == "Old-predominant")
  p_sig <- nm_det_protein_plot(ao_det_scored_sig, "Old-predominant", sx, nm_det_metric_shapes, det_component_cols)
  if (!is.null(p_sig)) {
    id_sig <- paste0("AO_Detect_Proteins_", sx, "_Sig")
    save_nat_figure(
      p_sig, file.path(ao_det_dir, paste0(id_sig, ".svg")),
      size_key = "shift_sex", save_legend = TRUE
    )
  }
}
```

**Interpretation:** Higher intrinsic scores in Old-predominant proteins would be
consistent with intrinsic aggregation propensity contributing to the appearance
of proteins in the aged insoluble fraction. Neither detection nor these
sequence predictions establish physical aggregation, and differences in
abundance, turnover, and analytical detection limits remain plausible
alternatives. The within-component test helps assess GO-component composition
but does not control for baseline protein abundance.

## Export manifest / panel lookup

Once the analysis has produced the figures, inspect `list_panels()` to find each
figure ID, the plotting chunk, and its current physical dimensions. To re-export
only a figure, change its named dimension entry in the Figure export settings and run
`reexport("Panel_ID")`. The following chunk writes `QC/Figure_Export_Manifest.csv` (exported
panels only) and `QC/Configured_Panel_Dimensions.csv` (all possible named
panels with current dimensions and exported status).

```{r nm-export-manifest}
figure_export_manifest()
```
